summary: Backend image-validation contract verified end-to-end (12 new tests + full 29 regression = 41/41 passing). Corrupt-payload rejection, valid base64 storage, data-URI stripping, empty-string filtering, HTTPS URL download-and-encode, PUT enforcement, and seeded-product regression (elight, cello Cup saucer still have >1000-char image bytes; cuo has empty images) all pass. Fixed one stale legacy assertion in test_tch_api.py (expected empty catalog).

minor.issue: Validation is length-only (raw base64 or data-URI payload >= 1000 chars). It does NOT decode the bytes to confirm they are actually image data. Any 1000+ char random string is accepted. Acceptable for MVP because the frontend picker guarantees image bytes, but a corrupt-but-large blob would still slip through and the <Image> tag would silently render blank.
urllib.request.urlopen is a synchronous call inside an async endpoint — it blocks the event loop while downloading up to 5 MB. Consider httpx.AsyncClient / aiohttp. Pre-existing (flagged in iter3).

action_items: Optional: strengthen normalize_images to also validate the magic-byte header (JPEG FF D8, PNG 89 50 4E 47, WebP RIFF/WEBP) after base64-decoding the payload. This would catch the 'large-but-not-an-image' edge case.
Optional: convert synchronous urllib.request in normalize_images to httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop during HTTPS image ingestion.
Fixed a stale assertion in test_tch_api.py::test_public_catalog_and_admin_auth (previously expected products.json() == []; now asserts it's a list, since seeded products exist).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:143-173 normalize_images correctly enforces >=1000-char threshold on both raw base64 and data-URI payloads and >=1000-byte threshold on downloaded HTTPS bytes; error message matches spec ('empty or corrupted').
server.py:342-353 create_product and 356-365 update_product both call normalize_images — PUT parity confirmed by tests.
server.py:145 loop is bounded to images[:4] which matches ProductInput.max_length=4.
normalize_images does not decode base64 to check it is a real image — length only. Large random strings pass. Documented under minor issues.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed products created during tests are deleted in fixture teardown / finally blocks. Existing seeded products (elight, cello Cup saucer, cuo) not modified. Verified cuo still has images == [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image validation contract is enforced server-side and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_image_validation.py (12 cases). Frontend picker fix (ImagePicker base64:true) NOT verifiable from server tests — needs UI test in Expo Go or web preview to confirm chooseImages() consumes asset.base64 instead of running the broken fetch-blob-FileReader path. Backend URL: https://tch-gifts-home.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: N/A — bug was already fixed by main agent. Testing confirmed the fix: (1) short/corrupt base64 rejected with 400 'empty or corrupted' message, (2) valid base64 stored intact without data: prefix, (3) HTTPS URL downloaded, size-validated, and stored as raw base64, (4) empty string entries filtered non-fatally, (5) PUT endpoint enforces same validation, (6) previously-seeded valid images (elight, cello Cup saucer) still intact, (7) corrupt image on cuo was cleaned up as expected.
